author: GamingBolt
description:
We were thinking about games that might not necessarily be huge successes, but are still enjoyable titles to dive into and Watch Dogs 2 immediately came to mind. We found ourselves looking back fondly on our time with it, and there was enough there to make us want to play it even ten years and a lot of other great games later. 

That’s clearly something worth investigating further, and investigate we did. Join us as we take a look at why and how this follow up to a rather lackluster first instalment might be the finest implementation of a very bold vision for the franchise that manages to stay relevant even a decade after it first hit the shelves, and with a lot of rivals to beat away.
title: Watch Dogs 2, 10 Years Later - A Flawed Open World That Still Has More Soul Than Most

author: GamingBolt
description:
Dinosaurs wielding oversized swords; sounds like a joke, right? Yet, Dinoblade is very much real, blending Soulslike combat with light RPG progression and exploration for a prehistoric adventure that’s already earned an enthusiastic reception. 

Ahead of its full release, there’s still plenty to know beyond its eye-catching, if absurd premise. Here are twelve things you need to know before buying Dinoblade.
title: Dinoblade - 15 Things You NEED To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
We’ve seen some stunners over the first half of 2026, and they’re all experiences that draw on their visual splendor to make the worlds they're trying to pull us into become ones that we can’t help but visit. 

It’s been hard to choose from a bevy of games whose graphics have been top-notch, but we managed to whittle it down to some of our favorites. From vast worlds with a lot of variety in their offerings to ones that double down on the themes their stories are trying to present, there’s something for everybody to enjoy here.

Join us as we take a look at ten titles from this year’s lineup that have managed to captivate us with their graphics even before the experiences they’ve offered had a chance to take hold.
title: 10 Best Video Game Graphics of 2026 So Far
